UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Verified Neon World Clock user profile stored at users/{uid}. Never stores plaintext passwords.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in Neon World Clock.

emailVerified.description: Verification status; must be true on verified profile persistence.

createdAt.description: Immutable Firestore server timestamp recorded when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp recorded when the profile was last updated.

WatchlistMovie.title: WatchlistMovie
WatchlistMovie.description: Movie saved in a verified user's My List / Watchlist subcollection at users/{uid}/watchlist/{movieId}.

uid.description: Owning Firebase Authentication UID matching parent user document.

movieId.description: Positive TMDB movie ID matching the document ID.

posterPath.description: Relative TMDB poster path or empty string.

backdropPath.description: Relative TMDB backdrop path or empty string.

releaseDate.description: Movie release date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or empty string.

addedAt.description: Immutable Firestore server timestamp recorded when added to My List.

/users/{uid}.description: Verified user profile documents isolated strictly to the owning authenticated user.

/users/{uid}/watchlist/{movieId}.description: User's synced My List / Watchlist movies isolated strictly to the owning verified user.
